items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He – to this day I credit him with any kind of intellect I have on the instrument or in music, from him.

ctx.x: So his thing was more discipline. He was trying to teach you the fundamentals.

Exactly, exactly. He – to this day I credit him with any kind of intellect I have on the instrument or in music, from him. He was interested in raising men and women that had some control and discipline. It really comes in handy.
Where do you think he got – was he – did he come out of the Army or something? Where did he get that kind of attitude?
